_doc: Bootstrap renders outreach/profiles.json from this template and IDEA.md (name, first sentence of the idea) on first boot and never overwrites it afterwards. {tracks}: A open-source funders, B startup credits and accelerators, R research grants; the bootstrap keeps all that fit the idea open. Edit the text by PR; the guard re-checks it on every run.

default.name: {org_name}
default.tagline: {org_name}: built on Ultrastable, the foundation for any autonomous system.
default.ask: We would like to understand whether this programme fits and what it would take to apply. If it does not fit, a pointer to a better programme is just as useful.
default.contact_route: Reply to the address on the application or contact page that was used.
